hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,sys,urllib.request; e=json.load(sys.stdin); ok=e.get("hook_event_name") == "Stop" and e.get("stop_hook_active") is not True; root=os.environ.get("PLUGIN_DATA") or os.path.expanduser("~/.config/xiaomi-band-codex-notify"); c=json.load(open(os.path.join(root,"config.json"))) if ok else {}; h=str(c.get("host") or "").replace("https://","").replace("http://","").split("/",1)[0]; p=str(c.get("port") or 8787); t=str(c.get("token") or ""); body=str(e.get("last_assistant_message") or "任务已完成").rstrip()[:1200] or "任务已完成，可以回来看结果了"; data=json.dumps({"type":"notify","source":"codex","title":"Codex 已完成","body":body},ensure_ascii=False).encode(); req=urllib.request.Request("http://"+h+":"+p+"/v1/notify",data=data,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+t,"Content-Type":"application/json"},method="POST"); urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2.5).read() if h and t else None' 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.commandWindows: py -c "import json,os,sys,urllib.request; e=json.load(sys.stdin); ok=e.get('hook_event_name') == 'Stop' and e.get('stop_hook_active') is not True; root=os.environ.get('PLUGIN_DATA') or os.path.expanduser('~/.config/xiaomi-band-codex-notify'); c=json.load(open(os.path.join(root,'config.json'))) if ok else {}; h=str(c.get('host') or '').replace('https://','').replace('http://','').split('/',1)[0]; p=str(c.get('port') or 8787); t=str(c.get('token') or ''); body=str(e.get('last_assistant_message') or '任务已完成').rstrip()[:1200] or '任务已完成，可以回来看结果了'; data=json.dumps({'type':'notify','source':'codex','title':'Codex 已完成','body':body},ensure_ascii=False).encode(); req=urllib.request.Request('http://'+h+':'+p+'/v1/notify',data=data,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+t,'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST'); urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2.5).read() if h and t else None" 2>NUL || exit /b 0
